title: Support `Sentry.SourceGenerators` via Visual Studio 2019 version 16.11
reason: This is a defect in the Sentry .NET package's source generator/analyzer compatibility with Visual Studio 2019/Roslyn, not a SaaS backend, self-hosted, or supported SDK-repository issue. No transfer history or ownership evidence supports another repository.
notes: Build-time .NET SDK analyzer failure. Only sentry-dotnet example in the routing dataset, so holding it out leaves zero dotnet examples.

title: Snuba seems to set timestamp_ms to a max value
reason: The failure is in Sentry's event/issue viewing path: malformed extreme timestamps produced by the Snuba/ClickHouse integration cause the UI to return HTTP 500. No evidence supports routing to an SDK repository or self-hosted repository; the underlying behavior is an application data/query handling bug.
notes: Self-hosted Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp error. Reporter-selected Product Area was Issues.

title: sentry import global silently drops all but one ProjectKey per project
reason: The defect is in Sentry core's global relocation/import implementation (`ProjectKey.write_relocation_import`), not in the self-hosted deployment repository or an SDK. It deterministically loses multiple project keys during import and can silently change DSNs.
notes: Self-hosted user, but the root cause cited is in src/sentry (ProjectKey relocation import). A STAY prediction is defensible; a mismatch here is not necessarily an agent error.

title: 404 when adding a new GH repository
reason: The issue concerns a self-hosted installation failing while configuring a GitHub repository integration. Similar confirmed routing history transferred equivalent self-hosted integration failures to getsentry/self-hosted.
notes: Self-hosted GitHub integration 404 with almost no detail (screenshot only). Reporter-selected Product Area was Settings - Repositories.

title: Taskworker KAFKA_TOPIC_OVERRIDES Ignored
reason: This is a Sentry core taskworker/Kafka topic-resolution defect. The detailed reproduction and stack trace indicate taskworker producers bypass configured topic overrides, causing authorization failures and broken ingestion-related processing. No evidence indicates the Helm/self-hosted repository owns the underlying application bug.
notes: Helm-chart deployment, but the analysis points to taskworker code in src/sentry. Ambiguous ownership.
